</DIV>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; We depend upon our ability to attract qualified personnel who possess the skills and experience necessary to meet the staffing requirements of our customers or to successfully bid for new customer projects.&nbsp; We must continually evaluate and upgrade our base of available qualified personnel to keep pace with changing customer needs and emerging technologies.&nbsp; Competition for individuals with proven professional or technical skills currently exists.&nbsp; We could have difficulty attracting and retaining sufficient numbers of qualified personnel necessary for our business to succeed.&nbsp; Additionally, increases in prevailing wage rates may negatively impact our financial results if we are unable to pass the higher costs on to customers through higher hourly bill rates.&nbsp; </FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><B><I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Regulatory challenges to our tax filing positions could result in additional taxes.</FONT></I></B></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">We file tax returns with various governmental entities within the United States and Canada.&nbsp; The filings include returns with the Federal government, the states and&nbsp;numerous cities, counties and municipalities.&nbsp; When we prepare these tax filings, we are required to follow numerous and complex legal and technical requirements where interpretation of rules and regulations is required.&nbsp; We believe that we have appropriately filed our tax returns and properly reported taxable transactions, but the final tax amounts are subject to regulatory audit and interpretation.&nbsp; We&nbsp;believe we&nbsp;have established adequate reserves with respect to any tax liabilities that may arise in relation to these transactions should our position be successfully challenged by tax authorities. However, an unfavorable settlement&nbsp;could result in&nbsp;higher payments and&nbsp;additional charges to income above the amounts reserved.&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: 0.5in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><B><I><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">We may lose key personnel, and therefore, our business may suffer. </FONT></I></B></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 7.5pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: 0.5in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Our operations are dependent on the continued efforts of our officers and executive management. In addition, we are dependent on the performance and productivity of our local managers and field personnel. Our ability to attract and retain business is significantly affected by local relationships and the quality of service rendered. The loss of those key officers and members of executive management who have acquired significant experience in our industry may cause a significant disruption to our business. Moreover, the loss of our key managers and field personnel may jeopardize existing customer relationships with businesses that continue to use our services based upon past relationships with these local managers and field personnel. The loss of such key personnel could materially adversely affect our operations, because it may result in an inability to establish and maintain customer relationships and otherwise operate our business. </FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: 0.5in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT></I><B><I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">We may be exposed to employment&#8209;related claims and costs that could have an adverse affect on our business, financial condition and results of operations.</FONT></I></B></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; We employ and place people in the workplaces of other businesses.&nbsp; Attendant risks of such activity that could increase our cost of doing business include:</FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 0.5in"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">possible claims of discrimination and harassment;</FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 0.5in"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">errors and omissions by the personnel we place, particularly for the acts of temporary professionals (e.g., accountants, attorneys, engineers and information technology consultants);</FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 0.5in"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">misuse or misappropriation of customer assets or proprietary information; and</FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 0.5in"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">payment of workers&#146; compensation and other similar claims. </FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 53pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="TEXT-INDENT: 0.5in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Although we maintain insurance coverage for general liability, errors and omissions and employee theft, such insurance coverage may not be adequate in scope or amount to cover any such liability.&nbsp; We retain all or a portion of the risk under our workers&#146; compensation, general liability, professional liability, and employment practices liability insurance programs.&nbsp; Changes in the estimates of accruals related to these retained risks are charged or credited to earnings in the period determined, and therefore a large fluctuation in any given quarter could adversely affect earnings in that period.&nbsp; A failure of any of our personnel to observe our policies and guidelines intended to reduce exposure to these risks could have a material effect upon us.</FONT></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt" align=center>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt" align=center><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; We self-insure, or otherwise bear financial responsibility for, a significant portion of expected losses under our workers&#146; compensation and health benefit programs. Unexpected changes in claim trends, including the severity and frequency of claims, actuarial estimates and medical cost inflation could result in costs that are significantly different than initially reported. If future claims-related liabilities increase due to unforeseen circumstances, our costs could increase significantly. There can be no assurance that we will be able to increase the fees charged to our customers or employees in a timely manner and in a sufficient amount to cover increased costs as a result of any changes in claims-related liabilities. </FONT></P>

<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>

<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>

<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.75in"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>

<A name="UnresolvedStaff"></A>None.</FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><B><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Item 2.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; PROPERTIES</FONT></B></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><B><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT></B>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><B><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
<A name="Properties"></A></FONT></B><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Our corporate headquarters&nbsp;is located at 2050 Spectrum Boulevard, Fort Lauderdale, Florida, in a 125,000 square-foot building owned by us. In addition, we lease approximately 56,000 square feet in Alpharetta, Georgia for operating functions. All other field locations operate in space held primarily under three to five year leases providing fixed monthly rentals. Our corporate headquarters and our field locations are used by both our Professional Services and our Staffing Services operating segments. We believe that our facilities are adequate for our needs.</FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.75in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.75in"><B><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Item 3.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; LEGAL PROCEEDINGS</FONT></B></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><B><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT></B>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
<A name="LegalProceed"></A>In the ordinary course of our business, we are or may be threatened with or named as a defendant in various lawsuits. We maintain insurance in such amounts and with such coverages and deductibles as we believe are reasonable and prudent. The principal risks that we insure against are workers&#146; compensation, personal injury, bodily injury, property damage, professional malpractice, errors and omissions, and fidelity losses. Our management does not expect that the outcome of any pending lawsuits relating to such matters, individually or collectively, will have a material adverse effect on our financial condition, results of operations or cash flows.</FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: 35.3pt; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">On December&nbsp;13, 2004, and as amended on January&nbsp;13, 2005 and October&nbsp;31, 2005, Glidepath Holding B.V. and Jeimon Holdings N.V., as plaintiffs, filed an action against SFN Group, Inc. in the U.S. District Court of the Southern District of New York.&nbsp; Glidepath and Jeimon Holdings, investors in the entity that acquired the Cyber Center business of Spherion Technology (UK) Limited, a subsidiary of SFN Group, Inc., in 2002, sued SFN for fraud, negligent misrepresentation, aiding and abetting, breach of fiduciary duty and unjust enrichment and seek $32.0 million in damages, and treble for punitive damages, plus attorneys&#146; fees, expert fees and costs.&nbsp; Glidepath and Jeimon Holdings allege that an individual who was an officer of Spherion Technology (UK) fraudulently induced them to invest in a corporation formed to purchase the CyberCenter business, while he remained in the employ of Spherion Technology (UK) and was to be paid an incentive bonus for the sale by SFN.&nbsp; They allege that he misled them as to his employment status at the time, as to the prospects for the CyberCenter, and as to whether the newly formed corporation was assuming the indebtedness of Spherion Technology (UK) associated with the CyberCenter business.&nbsp; They allege that in doing so, he was acting as SFN&#146;s agent.&nbsp; On November 14, 2008, based upon information obtained through discovery, SFN filed counterclaims against plaintiffs under theories of contract interference and unjust enrichment.&nbsp; SFN alleges that plaintiffs interfered with SFN&#146;s employment relationship with its Spherion Technology (UK) Limited officer, and recovered and retained damages in a U.K. arbitration proceeding against such officer, which damages belonged to SFN.&nbsp; Cross-motions for summary judgment were filed by the parties and fully briefed before the court on May 1, 2009.&nbsp; On March 30, 2010, the court granted SFN&#146;s motion for summary judgment in the action filed against SFN by plaintiffs </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Glidepath and Jeimon Holdings, and dismissed plaintiffs&#146; claims against SFN.&nbsp; The court also granted plaintiffs&#146; motion for summary judgment on the counterclaims asserted by SFN against the plaintiffs, and dismissed SFN&#146;s counterclaims against the plaintiffs.&nbsp; The plaintiffs have appealed the judgment granting SFN&#146;s motion for summary judgment, and SFN has cross-appealed the judgment granting the plaintiffs&#146; motion for summary judgment. The appeals have not yet been fully briefed, and a </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">hearing date for oral arguments on the appeals has not been set at this time.</FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp; SFN intends to continue vigorously defending this matter and management believes the likelihood of a loss is remote.&nbsp; SFN has a reserve of $0.4 million related to legal fees incurred to defend this matter and does not have insurance coverage for this claim.</FONT></P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><B><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT></B>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.75in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.75in"><B><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Item 4.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; (REMOVED AND RESERVED)</FONT></B></P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><B><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT></B>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-ALIGN: center; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt" align=center>

<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><B><I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Issuer Purchases of Equity Securities</FONT></I></B></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: 35pt; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">On February 17, 2009, the Board of Directors authorized the Company to repurchase up to an average of 50,000 shares per week or up to 2.6 million shares on a cumulative annual basis of the Company&#146;s common stock primarily for the purpose of offsetting dilution created through the Company&#146;s various employee benefit plans. The Plan authorized on February 17, 2009 does not have an expiration date. During 2010, SFN purchased 0.5 million shares for approximately $4.9 million at an average price per share of $9.63.&nbsp; During 2009, SFN purchased 2.4 million shares for approximately $8.9 million at an average price per share of $3.72.&nbsp; </FONT></P>

<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; The following graph compares the cumulative total stockholder return on our Common Stock with the cumulative total return of the NYSE composite index, our New Peer Group Index (the &#147;New Peer Group&#148;) and our Old Peer Group Index (the &#147;Old Peer Group Index&#148;), each for the period beginning December 30, 2005 and ending December 23, 2010.&nbsp; MPS Group, Inc. is included in the Old Peer Group until January 19, 2010 when it was purchased by Adecco, S.A., a company that is not traded in the U.S. In the New Peer Group, Resource Connection, Inc., a professional services staffing firm, replaces MPS Group, Inc.&nbsp; We believe the New Peer Group provides a more meaningful comparison of our performance compared with our primary competition for our important product offerings and other relevant factors.&nbsp; The total cumulative return on investment (change in stock price plus reinvested dividends, if any) for us, the NYSE composite index, the New Peer Group Index and the Old Peer Group Index assumes that a $100&nbsp;investment was made on December 30, 2005.&nbsp; We have not declared any dividends in the period represented in this performance graph.</FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>

<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 71pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Non-GAAP Financial Measures</FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 71pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Forward&#8209;Looking Statements-Safe Harbor </FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><B><I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT></I></B>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><B><I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Company Overview</FONT></I></B></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><B><I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT></I></B>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">SFN Group, Inc. is a strategic workforce solutions provider.&nbsp; We have two operating segments, Professional Services and Staffing Services which provide temporary staffing, outsourcing and other services and permanent placement under several specialty brands.&nbsp; Within Professional Services we operate as Technisource, The Mergis Group, Todays Office Professionals, SourceRight Solutions and Tatum.&nbsp; Within our Staffing Services segment we operate as Spherion.&nbsp; </FONT></P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Temporary staffing includes placing our employees at a customer location under the customer&#146;s supervision in the following skill categories: information technology, finance and accounting, administrative, legal, engineering, sales and marketing, human resources, light industrial and clerical.&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Outsourcing and other includes services where we manage aspects of the operation of a customer function such as recruiting, supplying contingent labor, independent contractor compliance and professional payrolling; these services are typically provided under long-term contracts.&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Permanent placement is a service where we locate talent on behalf of our customers, screen the candidates and assist in the recruitment efforts for a fee.&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">See the Business - Operations Overview section of Part&nbsp;I of this Annual Report on Form&nbsp;10-K for further description of our operating segments.</FONT></P>

<DIV style="PAGE-BREAK-BEFORE: always"></DIV>
<A name="page_22"></A><B><I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Executive Summary</FONT></I></B>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><B><I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT></I></B>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; The following is a brief summary of our primary 2010 objectives and accomplishments:</FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">We remain focused on executing our strategy to increase our exposure to higher value professional, outsourcing and other higher margin services.&nbsp; As the economy continues to improve in 2011, our activities center around three strategic planks</FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">: </FONT></P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 53pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"><I>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;First, increase sales activity among targeted customer groups:</I></FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 55pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">In the first quarter of 2010, SFN acquired Tatum, LLC, a leading executive services firm focused on the office of the CFO. This investment enhances our ability to provide high level finance and accounting talent to a wide range of customers.&nbsp; The acquisition of Tatum combined with growth in Technisource, Mergis and SourceRight increased our mix of Professional Services to 47.5% of total company revenues.</FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 55pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Our business with small and mid-sized customers was significantly impacted in 2009 by the economic downturn.&nbsp; During the second half of 2010, we began to see signs of increased hiring activity by our small and mid-sized customers as the economy continued to improve.&nbsp; During 2010, revenues from our small to mid-sized accounts (customers that do business with SFN of $5 million or less, annually) represented 44.5% of total revenues compared with 42.8% of revenues in the prior year. Additionally, we made operating investments in sales and recruiting staff, increasing our Professional Services associate headcount by 23.6% compared with the end of 2009, to further increase our growth among small and mid-sized customers.</FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 55pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">In late 2009, we formally launched the SourceRight Solutions brand and in 2010, we introduced our integrated offerings including our industry leading Recruitment Process Outsourcing (&#147;RPO&#148;) and Managed Service Programs (&#147;MSP&#148;).&nbsp; During 2010, RPO and MSP grew 69.7% and 44.6%, respectively, compared with the prior year</FONT><I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">.&nbsp; </FONT></I></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 53pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 53pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<I>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Second, improve profitability through operating effectiveness: </I></FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 55pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">We continue to maintain pricing discipline through active customer relationship management and opportunity selection. As a result of this discipline, we successfully managed pricing adjustments with many of our customers to mitigate a portion of the impact of higher state unemployment taxes in 2010.&nbsp; Pay/bill spreads in our temporary staffing services increased by 20 basis points in 2010 compared with 2009.</FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 55pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">In addition, we continue to carefully manage operating metrics and leverage our central recruiting capabilities to increase productivity in our field operations and improve operating margins.&nbsp; In 2010, despite significant increases in sales and recruiting resources, we reduced SG&amp;A to 89.6% of gross profit compared with 96.0% in the same period last year.</FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 53pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 53pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; <I>Third, maintain financial discipline: </I></FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 55pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Days sales outstanding (&#147;DSO&#148;) were 43 days at December 26, 2010 compared with 41 days at December 27, 2009, increasing in part due to growth in business with larger customers that have slightly longer payment terms. We have continued to maintain the quality of our accounts receivable portfolio from year to year. </FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 71pt">&nbsp;</P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">We remain focused on executing our strategy to increase our exposure to higher value professional, outsourcing and other higher margin services.&nbsp; As the economy continues to improve in 2011, our activities center around three strategic planks</FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">: </FONT></P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 55pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><I><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">First, continue investing in our business to drive targeted revenue growth:</FONT></I></P>
<P style="TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 71pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Increase exposure to higher value professional skills;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 71pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Maximize contribution from past and future increases in sales and recruiting staff to grow revenues among small and mid-sized customers;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 71pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Leverage SourceRight&#146;s leadership position in RPO and MSP to grow outsourcing revenues; and </FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 71pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Expand permanent placement services as market conditions allow.</FONT></P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 55pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><I><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Second, improve profitability through operating effectiveness:</FONT></I></P>
<P style="TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 71pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Maintain pricing discipline through active customer relationship management and opportunity selection; and</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 71pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Drive productivity improvements through metrics management, technology enhancements and centralized recruiting.</FONT></P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 1in"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 55pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><I><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Third, maintain financial discipline:</FONT></I></P>
<P style="TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 71pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Decrease day sales outstanding (&#147;DSO&#148;) below 2010 levels; and</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 71pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Actively manage capital spending.</FONT></P>

<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><B><I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Operating Results</FONT></I></B></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><B><I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT></I></B>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><B><I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Consolidated Operating Results</FONT></I></B></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><B><I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT></I></B>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: 0.5in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><B><I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Fiscal 2010 compared with 2009</FONT></I></B></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: 0.5in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><B><I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT></I></B>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.75in"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Revenues in 2010 were $2.1 billion, an increase from $1.7 billion last year.&nbsp; </FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 70pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">As economic conditions in North America continued to improve in 2010, our customers increased the hiring of temporary employees.&nbsp; Temporary employment in the U.S. increased by 15.0% year over year in 2010 as estimated by the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.&nbsp; The Company&#146;s temporary staffing revenues increased 17.4% to $1.8 billion from $1.6 billion in the prior year, including the impact of the Tatum acquisition which accounted for 4.9 percentage points of the year over year increase.&nbsp; Additionally, outsourcing and other revenues increased 49.9% to $197.2 million from $131.6 million in the same prior year period due to growth in RPO and managed services programs.&nbsp; In 2010, permanent placement revenues increased 28.1% to $32.9 million from $25.7 million in the same prior year period.</FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 70pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Professional Services revenues, including organic growth and the impact of the Tatum acquisition, increased 29.0% compared with the prior year, and now represents 47.5% of total company revenue.</FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 70pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Staffing Services revenues increased 12.9% compared with the prior year, primarily due to higher business volumes within existing customers.</FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.5in"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.75in"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Gross profit in 2010 was $424.0 million.&nbsp; Gross profit margin increased to 20.6% in 2010 compared with 19.8% for 2009.&nbsp; Gross profit margins increased due to:</FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 70pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Increased margins from a shift in mix within our services (30 basis points) primarily due to growth in professional temporary staffing, outsourcing and other services;</FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 70pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">An increase in temporary staffing margins in both segments (30 basis points) due to higher pay/bill spreads including the impact of the higher margin staffing from the acquired Tatum business and, lower employee burden costs; and </FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 70pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Improved outsourcing and other margins (20 basis points) due to higher recruiter productivity as business volumes increased. </FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 0.5in"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 0.75in"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">SG&amp;A expenses increased 16.7% to $380.1 million in 2010 from $325.7 million in 2009.&nbsp; The increase in SG&amp;A expenses is due to the Tatum acquisition during 2010 as well as investments in sales and recruiting personnel and increased variable compensation tied to improved operating results.&nbsp; As a percentage of gross profit, SG&amp;A costs decreased to 89.6 % from 96.0% in 2009.&nbsp; As business volumes continue to improve during 2011, we expect to manage the growth in expenses relative to growth in gross profit.</FONT></P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.25in"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.75in"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Restructuring and other charges were $3.3 million and $7.1 million in 2010 and 2009, respectively.&nbsp; The charges in 2010 related to acquisition integration and transaction costs from the Tatum acquisition, while the charges in2009 were primarily due to lease and severance costs related to cost containment efforts.&nbsp; See Note 15, &#147;Restructuring and Other Charges,&#148; in the accompanying notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements for further discussion.&nbsp; </FONT></P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.5in"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 0.75in"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Net interest expense was $5.8 million in 2010 compared with net interest expense of $4.0 million in 2009.&nbsp; The increase in net interest expense is primarily due to an increase in outstanding debt balances during the year from&nbsp;the financing of the Tatum acquisition.</FONT></P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 0.75in"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Our effective tax benefit rate from continuing operations for 2010 was 43.4% and was higher than the statutory rate due to the impact of non-income based state taxes.&nbsp; Our effective tax benefit rate from continuing operations for 2009 was 15.4% and was lower than the statutory rate due to the impact of non-income based state taxes and adjustments to valuation allowances</FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US color=#1f497d face="Times New Roman">.</FONT></P>

<P style="TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.5in"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Loss from discontinued operations was $0.00 per share in 2010 compared with a loss of $(0.01) per share in 2009, respectively.&nbsp; The loss in 2010 included $0.3 million of pre-tax loss (net of a $0.1 million tax benefit) from operations due to expenses related to the defense of certain legal matters associated with businesses sold in 2004.&nbsp; See Note 14, &#147;Discontinued Operations,&#148; in the accompanying notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements for further discussion.</FONT></P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.5in"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Effective in the fourth quarter of 2010, SFN changed its methodology of calculating Days Sales Outstanding (&#147;DSO&#148;) due to the growth of its MSP business.&nbsp; Prior years&#146; DSO was recalculated to conform to the 2010 calculation.&nbsp; DSO was 43 days at&nbsp;December 26, 2010 compared with 41 days at&nbsp;December 27, 2009, increasing in part due to growth in business with larger customers that have slightly longer payment terms.&nbsp; We have continued to maintain the quality of our accounts receivable portfolio from year to year.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.5in"><FONT size=2></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: 0.5in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><B><I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Fiscal 2009 compared with 2008</FONT></I></B></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: 0.5in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><B><I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT></I></B>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.5in"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Revenues in 2009 were $1.7 billion, a decrease from $2.2 billion in 2008.&nbsp; </FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.75in"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">In 2009, temporary employment in the U.S. decreased by 22.4% year over year as estimated by the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.&nbsp; The Company&#146;s temporary staffing revenues decreased 22.3% to $1.6 billion from $2.0 billion in the prior year. Additionally, outsourcing and other revenues increased 3.4% to $131.6 million from $127.2 million in the same prior year period due to growth in our professional payrolling business. In 2009, permanent placement revenues decreased 58.8% to $25.7 million from $62.3 million in the same prior year period.</FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.75in"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Professional Services revenues decreased 22.0% compared with the prior year and Staffing Services revenues decreased 21.8% compared with the prior year.&nbsp; The decline in both our Professional and Staffing Services revenues was primarily due to lower business volumes within existing customers.</FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 1in"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.5in"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Gross profit in 2009 was $339.1 million.&nbsp; Gross profit margin decreased to 19.8% in 2009 compared with 22.0% for 2008.&nbsp; Gross profit margins decreased due to:</FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.75in"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Shift in business mix (100 basis points) primarily, due to lower permanent placement volumes; </FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.75in"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Declines in temporary staffing margins in Staffing Services (50 basis points) and Professional Services (20 basis points) primarily due to a reduction in pay/bill spreads, higher payroll taxes and other employee burden costs;</FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.75in"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Lower outsourcing and other margins due primarily to growth in the professional payrolling business (50 basis points). </FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.5in"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">SG&amp;A expenses decreased 27.4% to $325.7 million in 2009 from $448.6 million in 2008.&nbsp; The decline in SG&amp;A expenses was due to adjustments made to our cost structure as business volumes decreased in 2009.&nbsp; As a percentage of gross profit, SG&amp;A costs increased to 96.0% from 93.1% in 2008.</FONT></P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.25in"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.5in"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Restructuring and other charges were $7.1 million and $11.4 million in 2009 and 2008, respectively.&nbsp; The charges in 2009 and 2008 were primarily due to lease and severance costs related to cost containment efforts.&nbsp; Additionally, included in 2009 were charges of $1.7 million related primarily to adverse developments in a prior year legal matter.&nbsp; We also recorded an intangible asset and goodwill impairment charge of $2.9 million and $149.8 million in the fourth quarter of 2009 and 2008, respectively.</FONT></P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 0.75in"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 0.5in"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Net interest expense was $4.0 million in 2009 compared with net interest expense of $5.3 million in 2008.&nbsp; The decrease in interest expense was primarily due to the reduction in average outstanding debt balances, partially offset by higher interest rate spreads due to changes associated with our amended credit facility (see &#147;MD&amp;A-Financing&#148; for further discussion).&nbsp; Outstanding debt decreased from $39.3 million at December 28, 2008 to $13.6 million at December 27, 2009.&nbsp; </FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: 0in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 35pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<UL style="MARGIN-TOP: 0in; MARGIN-BOTTOM: 0in" type=disc>
<LI style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp; Our effective tax benefit rate from continuing operations for 2009 was 15.4% and was lower than the statutory rate due to the impact of state taxes and adjustments to valuation allowances.&nbsp; The 2008 tax benefit rate of 18.9% was lower than the statutory rate due to non-deductible goodwill and intangible impairment charges.&nbsp; </FONT></LI></UL>

<P style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 38pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">DSO improved to 41 days at the end of 2009 compared with 45 days at the end of 2008.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 38pt"><FONT size=2></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><B><I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Operating Segments</FONT></I></B></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><B><I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT></I></B>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">SFN has two operating segments: Professional Services and Staffing Services. &nbsp;SFN evaluates the performance of its operating segments and allocates resources based on revenues, gross profit and segment operating profit.&nbsp; Segment operating profit is defined as income before unallocated corporate costs, goodwill and intangible asset impairment, amortization expense, interest expense, interest income, income taxes and restructuring and other charges.&nbsp; All intercompany revenues and expenses have been eliminated</FONT><I><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">.&nbsp; </FONT></I><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Additionally, amounts related to discontinued operations have been excluded from the segment information below and are presented as discontinued operations in the Condensed Consolidated Statements of Operations.&nbsp; As a result of internal organizational and business strategy changes, SFN realigned its operating segments during the first quarter of 2010. The historical segment information has been adjusted to conform to SFN&#146;s segment presentation in 2010, moving the MSP and professional contingent workforce services operated under the SourceRight brand into Professional Services from Staffing Services. All of SourceRight is also now reported in Outsourcing and Other in our service line reporting and in the Other skill category.&nbsp; In addition, several large clerical customers previously reported as part of Professional Services are now managed and reported as part of Staffing Services.&nbsp; </FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>

</TD>
     <TD style="BORDER-RIGHT: medium none" vAlign=bottom width="1%" noWrap align=left>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 8pt" face="Times New Roman">%</FONT></P>

     <TD style="HEIGHT: 12.95pt" vAlign=bottom width="2%" noWrap>

     <TD style="HEIGHT: 12.95pt; BORDER-RIGHT: medium none" vAlign=bottom width="9%" noWrap>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-ALIGN: right; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt" align=right><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 8pt" face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
</TD>
     <TD style="BORDER-RIGHT: medium none" vAlign=bottom width="1%" noWrap align=right></TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><B><I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT></I></B>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><B><I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Fiscal 2010 compared with 2009</FONT></I></B></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><B><I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT></I></B>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Revenues</FONT></I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&#151;</FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Professional Services revenues were $975.9 million or 47.5% of total revenues during 2010 compared to $756.8 million or 44.2% in the prior year. Revenues increased 29.0% compared with the prior year, including 10.3 percentage points contributed from the acquisition of Tatum and increasing demand from customers across all skills and service lines as the economy continued to improve.</FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 71pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">By skill&#151;Information technology (&#147;IT&#148;) increased 11.9% to $504.1 million compared with $450.4 million in the same prior year period.&nbsp; IT revenues increased due to the addition of Tatum combined with increases in demand from several large customers, particularly in the technology and financial services sectors. Finance and accounting revenues increased 97.7% in 2010 compared with the prior year due to the impact of the Tatum acquisition which contributed 76.8 percentage points of the year over year finance and accounting growth and growth within several clients in the financial services industry. Revenues from administrative skills increased 13.8% compared to the prior year. &nbsp;Other skills increased 43.8% and primarily reflect substantial growth in our RPO and our professional contingent workforce services businesses.&nbsp; Demand across all skills increased due to the improvement in the U.S. economy as well as the increase in overall industry wide temporary staffing levels. </FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 53pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 71pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">By service&#151;Temporary staffing increased 24.3% in 2010 compared with the prior year due to the Tatum acquisition which contributed 12.5 percentage points of the increase combined with an improving economy which has resulted in higher demand across our customer base.&nbsp; Outsourcing and other revenues increased 49.9% due to an increase in professional contingent workforce services projects and RPO growth.&nbsp; Permanent placement revenues increased 30.6% as a result of increased hiring due to improvement in the economy and the Tatum acquisition.</FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 71pt" align=center><FONT size=2></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 71pt" align=center><FONT size=2>23</FONT></P>
<HR color=#808080 SIZE=3 width="100%">
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 71pt" align=center></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 71pt"><FONT size=2></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<DIV><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</DIV>
<A name="page_27"></A>
<DIV>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: center; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt" align=center>&nbsp;</P>
</DIV>
<P style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Gross Profit</FONT></I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&#151;Professional Services gross profit increased to $252.9 million </FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">in 2010 from $189.9 million of revenues in the prior year.&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">The overall gross profit margin was 25.9% in 2010 compared with 25.1% in the prior year.&nbsp; This 80 basis point increase in gross profit margin was due to an increase in temporary staffing margins, primarily due to lower employee burden costs and the addition of higher margin staffing from Tatum (40 basis points) and an increase in outsourcing and other margins (50 basis points) due to improved margins and growth in RPO compared with other outsourcing services, offset by changes in the mix of business (10 basis points).</FONT></P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Segment Operating Profit</FONT></I><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&#151;Professional Services segment operating profit was $38.6 million or 4.0% of revenues in 2010 compared with $26.5 million or 3.5% of revenues in the prior year.&nbsp; As a percentage of gross profit, operating expenses decreased to 84.7% from 86.0%.&nbsp; The decrease in operating expenses as a percentage of gross profit was primarily due to continued effective management of our cost structure partially offset by Tatum, which had a negative contribution to segment operating profit.&nbsp; </FONT></P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Outlook</FONT></I><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&#151;We continue to focus on the execution of our strategy to expand Professional Services through investment in sales and recruiting resources focused on our targeted small and mid-sized accounts and permanent placement services.&nbsp; We are also making strategic investments in the growth of SourceRight Solutions and brand awareness. We continue to improve our productivity and maintain our pricing discipline while investing in the business to respond to growth opportunities in the professional services market in the future.&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><B><I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Fiscal 2009 compared with 2008</FONT></I></B></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><B><I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT></I></B>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Revenues</FONT></I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&#151;</FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Professional Services revenues decreased 22.0% to $756.8 million in 2009 from $969.8 million in 2008.&nbsp; The decrease in revenues was attributable to the lower business volumes from customers across all service lines and skill categories due to the weak economic conditions that occurred in 2009.</FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 71pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">By skill&#151;ITdecreased 22.3% from the prior year primarily due to the completion of a large IT staffing project in mid-2008 and lower demand from several large customers.&nbsp; Finance and accounting revenues decreased 14.7% compared with the prior year due to lower customer demand, including significant decreases in permanent placement activity across all skills.&nbsp; Administrative revenues decreased 50.6% due to declines in several larger customers in the technology and financial services industries as well as lower demand in general due to the weak U.S. economy.&nbsp; Other skills decreased 8.6% and primarily reflected a slowdown in our RPO business due to client hiring freezes and deferrals as the U.S. economy remained weak, offset by growth in our professional contingent workforce services business. </FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 53pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 71pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">By service&#151;Temporary staffing decreased 23.7% in 2009 compared with the prior year due to the slower economy.&nbsp; Outsourcing and other revenues increased 3.4% due to increases in professional contingent workforce services, partially offset by lower RPO revenues.&nbsp; Permanent placement revenues decreased by 60.1%, as a result of customer decisions to defer hiring due to economic uncertainty.</FONT></P>
<P style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: avoid; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0in 53pt"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Gross Profit</FONT></I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&#151;</FONT><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Professional Services gross profit decreased to $189.9 million or 25.1% of revenues in 2009 from $276.2 million or 28.5% of revenues in the prior year.&nbsp; This 340 basis point decrease in gross profit margin was due to:</FONT></P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="LINE-HEIGHT: normal; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 1in"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">A change in business mix primarily due to lower permanent placement revenues (170 basis points);</FONT></P>
<P style="LINE-HEIGHT: normal; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 1in"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Lower temporary staffing margins (50 basis points) driven by lower pay/bill spreads and higher payroll taxes which were partially offset by lower employee benefit cost;</FONT></P>
<P style="LINE-HEIGHT: normal; TEXT-INDENT: -0.25in; MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt 1in"><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face=Symbol>&#183;</FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 7pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </FONT><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">Lower outsourcing and other margins due to growth in the professional payrolling business (140 basis points), partially offset by higher margins in our RPO business (20 basis points).</FONT></P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>
<P style="MARGIN: 0in 0in 0pt"><I><FONT style="LETTER-SPACING: -0.1pt; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Segment Operating Profit</FONT></I><FONT style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt" lang=EN-US face="Times New Roman">&#151;Professional Services segment operating profit was $26.5 million in 2009 compared with $46.0 million in the prior year.&nbsp; Although we significantly decreased operating expenses to $163.4 million from $230.2 million, operating expenses as a percentage of gross profit&nbsp;increased to 86.0% from 83.3%.&nbsp; The increase in operating expenses as a percentage of gross profit was primarily due to deleveraging as business volumes and gross profit margins decreased at a more rapid rate than related costs.&nbsp; </FONT></P>
